name: Void Club
creator: Lycon
description: Void Club is one of VRChat's earliest well-known dance clubs, created in January 2018 and substantially redesigned in April of that year. It combines a bar, dance floor, and private rooms, and for years ran music around the clock as a public gathering spot. As a long-running, high-traffic public lobby it developed a mixed reputation depending on who visited, but remained an iconic fixture of VRChat's early nightlife scene.
